entries.title: Cave Story
entries.definitive_edition: Cave Story+ 2026 Steam update on Windows PC, with Cave Story 3D as optional secondary

emulation.emulator: Native Windows PC / native Nintendo 3DS secondary
emulation.notes: Use current Cave Story+ on PC for the main run; use Cave Story 3D only for the distinct remake layer.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Cave Story+ 2026 PC feature set with optional 3DS remake coverage.

primary.why: The Windows PC Cave Story+ route is the best main-play version after the 2026 Steam update because it brings the later console/Switch additions to PC: two-player mode, mod support, enhanced visuals, widescreen support, multiple soundtrack options, and challenge content such as Sand Pit, while preserving PC capture/settings flexibility. Cave Story 3D is visually distinct and has an additional 3D-remake layer, so it is a secondary curiosity rather than the main route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Cave Story+ on Steam for Windows PC, update to the 2026 build, and play that as the main route. If strict version-history coverage matters, also sample Cave Story 3D on Nintendo 3DS for its polygonal remake layer and additional level/crossover content.

secondary.exclusive_content: Cave Story 3D: 2.5D polygonal remake, remixed soundtrack, dynamic camera, another additional level, and Japanese-version crossover content.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample Cave Story 3D after the PC Cave Story+ route for the 3D remake presentation and its distinct extra content.
secondary.why: Cave Story 3D is not the clean definitive route because it loses some modes compared with other versions, but it is a distinct remake layer.

entries.remaster_caveats: Cave Story 3D is a separate 2.5D remake layer and not a replacement for Cave Story+; the original freeware release remains historically important but is not the complete modern route.
